answer: A sybil operator steers thousands of heads with one mind, so force every identity to post an irreversible forecast each epoch on an uncertain outside event. Each head stakes its epoch reward on accuracy, settled against the realized outcome on an ivory ledger. Clones face a trap: cluster forecasts and the ledger pools them into one shared berth, like identical ships at a wharf; spread them and the operator must think independently per head at real cost. Public forecasts are a lantern that makes sameness visible, so a farm's heads cannibalize each other while an honest agent thinks only once.
